local page = 1
local total_pages = 1
local cutoff = "2026-06-03"  -- more than 7 days before 2026-06-10
local matched = {}

repeat
  local r = tool('list_tickets', { page = page, status = 'open' })
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local created = it.created_at or ""
    -- created_at more than 7 days ago: before 2026-06-03
    if created < cutoff or (created:sub(1,10) < cutoff) then
      local full = tool('get_ticket', { id = it.id })
      local body = (full.body or ""):lower()
      if body:find("refund", 1, true) then
        matched[#matched + 1] = { id = it.id, created_at = created, subject = it.subject }
      end
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > total_pages

-- escalate each
local escalated = {}
for _, m in ipairs(matched) do
  tool('update_ticket', { id = m.id, priority = 'high', add_tags = { 'billing-escalation' } })
  escalated[#escalated + 1] = m.id
end

return { matched = matched, escalated_ticket_ids = escalated }
